patterns.note: A full-bleed hero video background subtly persists throughout the entire page, transitioning into a desaturated, fixed background image that unifies all content sections.
A playful, oversized, bold sans-serif display font is used for the main conference branding, contrasted with an elegant serif font for section headings and a clean sans-serif for body text.
A vibrant, energetic blue is used as a primary accent color for calls-to-action and key branding elements, standing out against a largely neutral palette of off-white and dark grey.
The main hero text (conference name and tagline) scrolls up and fades out as the user scrolls down, while a sticky 'Register' button with a price remains fixed at the bottom right of the viewport.
Content is organized into distinct, generously spaced sections, each introduced by a large, centered serif heading, giving an editorial and structured feel.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video background is used in the hero section, which then transitions into a fixed, highly desaturated or overlaid background image that subtly unifies the entire page content as the user scrolls.
The main hero text animates out of view with a fade and scroll-up effect using CSS keyframes as the user scrolls down, revealing the content below.
A persistent, sticky call-to-action button with a price indicator is anchored to the bottom right of the viewport, maintaining a clear conversion path.

design_tokens.type_scale: Features an oversized, bold sans-serif display font for the hero and main branding, contrasted with a more traditional, readable serif for section titles and a clean sans-serif for body text, creating a clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 8-12px) are consistently applied to buttons, image containers (speakers), and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and balanced spacing within content blocks, contributing to a clean, uncluttered feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the continuous, subtle background video/image that persists throughout the entire page, creating a cohesive and immersive experience. This is effectively combined with the playful, oversized typography for the conference branding and a direct, sticky call-to-action with pricing.
